ideas.title: Following the Money in Government Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial aspects of government investigations, including the Feeding Our Future case and the ICE officer investigation.
questions: What are the financial implications of these investigations?
How can we ensure transparency and accountability in government agencies?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a deeper understanding of the motivations and actions of those involved in these investigations. This can help to identify patterns and connections that may not be immediately apparent.
